{"cards":[
{"id":"1990s-rave-flyers","lines":{
"list-row":[4,"Each row is a stacked flyer strip: the key fact (price or date) in huge acid green condensed type, name and details small in white below, saved rows get an orange bar."],
"card":[4,"The card is a photocopied flyer: one giant acid green headline for the main fact, toner noise only on its header, details in plain white condensed lines underneath."],
"map":[3,"The map becomes a black xeroxed street plan with real north-up geography, pins as acid green blocks holding the price, the chosen pin inverted to orange."],
"form-field":[5,"Fields are stacked flyer lines: a condensed uppercase label above a square white-outlined box with plain typed text, errors in hot orange with a written message."],
"chip-filter":[5,"Filters are square slab stickers in a tight row; the chosen one fills acid green with black text and an x to clear, others stay outlined."],
"search":[4,"The search field is one wide black bar with a huge condensed green query as you type, suggestions listed below as plain white flyer lines."]}},
{"id":"35mm-slide-mount","lines":{
"list-row":[4,"Each row is a small slide mount on the light table: thumbnail in the rounded window, title and date typed on the edge label, chosen row glows teal."],
"card":[4,"The card is a square yellow slide mount with the image in its window and a typed caption strip along one edge holding name, price and date."],
"map":[3,"The map is a transparency lit from below on the light table, real geography north up, pins as tiny slide mounts holding the price, the chosen one glowing."],
"form-field":[5,"Each field is a slide label strip: a typed small label above a plain input with a mount-gray frame, errors shown in text with a red edge."],
"chip-filter":[4,"Filters are small slide mounts in a tray row; the picked mount lifts and fills yellow with a visible x to clear."],
"search":[4,"The search is a viewer slot with a plain typed query, and suggestions drop as a short stack of slide-label lines in a readable grotesk."]}},
{"id":"70-percent-empty-space","lines":{
"list-row":[5,"Rows are single wall labels with wide empty space between them: title, price and place in plain serif, the chosen row marked by a small red sold dot."],
"card":[5,"The card is one small work hung alone on the wall, image and a short label below it, with at least two thirds of its area left empty."],
"map":[3,"The map is a small framed plan in the center of a plaster wall, real geography north up, pins as small black dots with the price label, chosen dot red."],
"form-field":[5,"Only one field shows per view, hung like a single work with its serif label above and typed text plain, a short red error line below."],
"chip-filter":[5,"Filters are plain serif words in one quiet line, the chosen word underlined with a red dot and an x to clear."],
"search":[5,"The search is one thin underlined line in a large empty wall, the typed query in serif, suggestions as a few wall-label lines below."]}},
{"id":"8-bit-1985","lines":{
"list-row":[4,"Each row is a level line: a pixel sprite icon, name in mono, price as a score counter on the right, the chosen row marked with a magenta cursor arrow."],
"card":[4,"The card is a tile screen with a hard pixel border, image snapped to a chunky grid, name and price as mono score text and lives-style rating hearts."],
"map":[3,"The map is a tile grid overworld with real geography north up, pins as pixel flags with prices, the chosen flag blinking magenta in steps."],
"form-field":[5,"Fields are boxed pixel inputs with a mono label like PLAYER NAME, a blocky cursor, and errors in plain text with a magenta border."],
"chip-filter":[5,"Filters are pixel buttons in a row like menu options; the chosen one fills magenta with a cursor arrow and an x button to clear."],
"search":[4,"The search is a high-score style entry bar with a blinking block cursor, typed query in plain mono, suggestions as a menu list with an arrow cursor."]}},
{"id":"8-bit-pixels-only","lines":{
"list-row":[5,"Rows are pixel-edged strips with a small sprite icon, name and price in plain mono, a selected row filling orange with a whole-cell swap."],
"card":[4,"The card has a stepped pixel border and a pixelated image block, with name and price in plain mono and a scanline only on the hero card."],
"map":[3,"The map is redrawn on a visible pixel grid, real geography north up, pins as 8 px sprites with price labels, the chosen pin swapping to orange."],
"form-field":[5,"Fields are square pixel boxes with mono labels, a block cursor, and a hard orange outline plus text message when something is wrong."],
"chip-filter":[5,"Filters are pixel toggle blocks; picking one swaps the whole cell to orange with a check, and a pixel x clears it."],
"search":[5,"The search is a pixel-framed bar with a block cursor and the typed query in mono, suggestions as a stepped list with a pixel arrow on the focused line."]}},
{"id":"a-frame-around-everything","lines":{
"list-row":[5,"Rows are matted entries inside the frame: a thin black rule between them, title and price in plain grotesk, the chosen row marked by a red label tab."],
"card":[5,"The card is a small print in its own mat: a cream border around the image, caption and price beneath like a gallery label in grotesk."],
"map":[3,"The map sits inside a thick black frame with a cream mat, real geography north up, pins as small gallery label tags with prices, the chosen one red."],
"form-field":[5,"Each field is a framed box on the mat with a label above like a gallery caption, typed text plain, errors in red text beneath."],
"chip-filter":[5,"Filters are small mat-board tabs in a row; the chosen tab fills black with cream text and an x to clear."],
"search":[5,"The search is a framed slot inside the top mat band, plain typed query, suggestions listed below as caption lines on cream."]}},
{"id":"a-receipt-width-column-only","lines":{
"list-row":[5,"Each row is a receipt item line: name on the left, a dotted leader, price on the right in mono, the chosen line marked with a red tape stripe."],
"card":[4,"The card is a short receipt slip: item name, dotted leader lines for details and price, with a bold total line at the bottom and a torn edge."],
"map":[2,"The map is a small receipt-width inset in real geography, north up, with pins as numbered marks matching a printed list of places and prices below."],
"form-field":[5,"Fields print as receipt lines: a mono label, dotted leader and a plain typed value, with errors printed as a red tape line beneath."],
"chip-filter":[5,"Filters are printed options in brackets like [ UNDER 500 ]; the chosen one prints bold with a check and an x to clear."],
"search":[5,"The search is a single receipt line with a typed query after a prompt and dotted leader, suggestions printed as item lines below."]}},
{"id":"a-ruler-down-one-side","lines":{
"list-row":[4,"Rows line up beside the ruler with each row starting at a tick, number on the scale, name and price plain in mono, the chosen row flagged by the red marker."],
"card":[5,"The card has a small tick scale on its left edge, image and details plain beside it, with a red notch showing the item's position in the set."],
"map":[3,"The map gets a ruler along its edge with tick marks matching the scale, real geography north up, pins as plain marks with price, the chosen one red."],
"form-field":[5,"Fields sit on a ruled line with ticks beneath, the mono label above, typed text plain, and errors in red text with a red tick."],
"chip-filter":[4,"A range filter is a ruler slider with ticks and a red marker for each end, plain number labels, and chips beside it with a visible selected fill and x."],
"search":[5,"The search is a ruled bar with small ticks along its bottom, plain mono query, suggestions listed under it with numbered tick positions."]}},
{"id":"a-single-accent-shape-repeats","lines":{
"list-row":[5,"Rows are plain graphite text on chalk, and the chosen row gets a small signal orange quarter circle at its left, the one repeated shape."],
"card":[4,"The card is plain with name and price in grotesk, and a signal orange quarter circle sits in its corner, halftone filled only on the hero card."],
"map":[4,"The map is a quiet gray real map north up, pins as orange quarter circles holding prices, the chosen one larger and solid."],
"form-field":[5,"Fields are plain underlined inputs with clear labels, and the focused field shows an orange quarter circle at the left, errors in text beside it."],
"chip-filter":[5,"Filters are plain outlined chips; the chosen chip shows an orange quarter circle, filled text weight and an x to clear."],
"search":[5,"The search is a plain wide field with the typed query in graphite, an orange quarter circle as the search icon, suggestions in a simple list."]}},
{"id":"a-single-horizontal-scroll","lines":{
"list-row":[4,"Rows become frames on the film strip, each a tall panel with name, price and details plain in condensed type, the chosen frame lit amber."],
"card":[4,"The card is one film frame on the track with sprocket holes above, image plain, frame number and details in condensed type beneath."],
"map":[3,"The map is a wide frame on the strip with real geography north up, pins as small amber frame marks with prices, the chosen one solid."],
"form-field":[4,"Each field is its own frame on the strip with a large label and plain input, a next arrow advances, and errors show as amber text."],
"chip-filter":[5,"Filters are a row of film-can label tabs at the start of the track; the chosen tab fills amber with an x to clear."],
"search":[4,"The search is the first frame of the strip: a wide plain field with a typed query, suggestions as small frames in a row beneath."]}},
{"id":"a-single-scrolling-ticker","lines":{
"list-row":[5,"Rows stay still as plain condensed lines with name and price like a station board, and an updated row flashes amber once and is also sent to the ticker."],
"card":[5,"The card stays static with plain details, and any change to it appears as one amber line in the ticker, with a small amber dot on the card."],
"map":[3,"The map stays still with real geography north up and plain pins, while changes to places run in the ticker and the related pin ringed amber."],
"form-field":[5,"Fields stay plain with clear labels and typed text, errors shown in text beside the field and also sent once to the ticker."],
"chip-filter":[5,"Filters are plain chips with a visible selected fill and x, and the count of results changes is announced as one ticker line."],
"search":[5,"The search is a plain field with the typed query and a static suggestions list, and new results are read out once in the ticker."]}},
{"id":"a-sparkline-beside-every-number","lines":{
"list-row":[4,"Each row ends with its price in mono and a tiny sparkline beside it, green when up and red when down, with the chosen row marked by a baseline rule."],
"card":[4,"The card shows its price large in mono with a small sparkline beside it showing recent change, plus a plain text label for the trend."],
"map":[3,"The map keeps real geography north up, with pins showing price and a tiny sparkline in the pin callout for the chosen place."],
"form-field":[4,"Numeric fields show a typed value in mono with a tiny sparkline of past entries beside it, and errors in red text under the field."],
"chip-filter":[4,"Range filters show a small histogram sparkline above the slider, chips beside it with a visible selected fill and an x to clear."],
"search":[4,"The search shows the typed query plain, and each suggestion has a small sparkline beside its figure for a quick trend."]}}
]}
